# Notice of Public Meeting
## City of Gloucester
### REVISED
Historic District Commission
September 29, 2026 6:00 PM
Rose Baker Center for Aging Well 2nd floor Conference Room
6 Manuel F. Lewis Street
Gloucester, MA 01930

Posted: 2026 SEP 22

The public is welcome to attend in person.
Zoom link to access the meeting remotely is also available:

Join from Computer, Smart Device: https://gloucester-ma-gov.zoom.us/j/89204672359
Join via Phone: +1 (312) 626-6799, Alternate: +1 (929) 205-6099
Meeting ID: 89204672359

Please visit http://gloucester-ma.gov/remote-public-meetings for instructions and guidance on how to join a remote meeting. Please note that the in-person meeting will not be suspended or terminated if technological problems interrupt the remote connection.

Listed items may be heard out of order.

- Call to Order
- Introduction/Attendance of the members
- Approval of the 7/28/2026 and 8/25/2026 minutes

## New Business

**38 Pleasant Street** (Map 14, Lot 17) – Michael Craviero requesting a COA for replacement of front door

**33 Middle Street** (Map 7, Lot 85) – Beth Lazazzera and Michael Ibba requesting a COA for the installation of gutters and downspouts

**52 Main Street** (Map 7, Lot 77) – Paula Realty II LLC seeking a Certificate of Appropriateness (COA) for HVAC replacement on roof

**17 Pleasant Street** (Map 8, Lot 73) – William Davis requesting COA for a Sign permit

## Board Discussion

**48 and 48R Middle St.** St John's Episcopal Church pre-application for siding and window replacement of parish hall and repainting exterior of sanctuary.

HDC proposed Rules and Regulations review

## Adjournment

The listing of matters is those reasonably anticipated by the Chair, which may be discussed at the meeting. Not all items may, in fact, be discussed, and other items not listed may also be brought up for discussion to the extent permitted by law.
headline: Certificates of appropriateness will be considered for a front door, gutters, HVAC unit, and sign, plus a church renovation pre-application.
summary: The meeting will cover four requests for Certificates of Appropriateness, covering a front door replacement at 38 Pleasant Street, gutters and downspouts at 33 Middle Street, HVAC replacement at 52 Main Street, and a sign permit at 17 Pleasant Street. The board will also discuss a pre-application from St John's Episcopal Church for siding, window, and exterior painting work at 48 and 48R Middle St., and review proposed Rules and Regulations.
